name: opencode-mission
description: Persistent Codex-style Mission runtime for OpenCode: verified multi-turn objectives, budgets, auto-continuation, and circuit breakers.

scripts.test:unit: node --test test/core.test.js test/adapter.test.js test/store.test.js test/ledger.test.js test/scheduler.test.js test/traversal.test.js
scripts.test:smoke: node test/server-smoke.mjs && node test/continuation-smoke.mjs && node test/budget-wrapup-smoke.mjs && node test/restart-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.check: npm run build:local && node --check src/core.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/ledger.js && node --check src/adapter.js && node --check src/scheduler.js && node --check src/traversal.js && node --check dist/mission.js && node -e "import('./dist/mission.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.MissionPlugin !== 'function') process.exit(1) })" && npm run test
